messages.rawText: IMPORTANT NBEMS NOTICE: FMGE December 2026 examination schedule notification announced.

Which of the following is the drug of choice for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (PSVT)?
A) Adenosine
B) Amiodarone
C) Verapamil
D) Digoxin
Ans: A
Exp: IV Adenosine is first line.

Observe the clinical video showing rhythmic horizontal eye oscillation. Diagnosis?
A) Horizontal Jerk Nystagmus
B) Opsoclonus
C) Ocular flutter
D) Saccades
Ans: A
Exp: Jerk nystagmus with slow drift.

A 45-year-old male presents with epigastric pain radiating to back. CT abdomen is attached. What is the diagnosis?
A) Acute pancreatitis
B) Peptic ulcer
C) Cholecystitis
D) Appendicitis
Ans: A
Exp: CT demonstrates necrotizing pancreatitis.

Which of the following is the drug of choice for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (PSVT)?
A) Adenosine
B) Amiodarone
C) Verapamil
D) Digoxin
Ans: A
Exp: IV Adenosine (6mg rapid bolus) is the first-line drug of choice for acute termination of stable PSVT.
